summary: Enbridge Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement on a November 9, 2026 shelf registration for a US$1.1 billion subordinated note offering: US$550 million 6.700% Series A and US$550 million 6.875% Series B Fixed-to-Fixed Rate Subordinated Notes due 2057. Both series carry a five-year Treasury reset after 2032 and 2037 respectively, with floors at the initial coupons, and permit interest deferral up to five years under a dividend stopper. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or change-of-control terms are disclosed. This is a routine capital-markets takedown, not a special situation; watch rate reset spreads and deferral language for credit positioning.
